facts.fact: Most CTV retargeting platforms require a minimum audience size of roughly 1,000-5,000 matched users before serving ads.
facts.quote: Most platforms require a minimum audience size before serving ads, typically 1,000-5,000 matched users.

facts.fact: TV ads are typically 15 or 30 seconds long.
facts.quote: TV ads are typically 15 or 30 seconds. With [Adwave](https://adwave.com/how-it-works/), you can create professional video ads even if you don't have existing video assets.

facts.fact: A common budget split for CTV is 70-80% prospecting and 20-30% retargeting.
facts.quote: A common split is 70-80% prospecting, 20-30% retargeting.

facts.fact: The guide suggests prioritizing CTV retargeting when a website has significant traffic, specifically 5,000+ monthly visitors.
facts.quote: You have significant website traffic (5,000+ monthly visitors)

facts.fact: Common frequency caps for retargeting audiences range from 3-5 impressions per week.
facts.quote: Common caps range from 3-5 impressions per week for retargeting audiences.

facts.fact: The guide recommends focusing CTV retargeting budget on recent website visitors within a 7-30 day recency window.
facts.quote: Focus budget on recent visitors (7-30 days).

facts.fact: Post-view attribution windows for CTV conversions are typically 7-30 days after ad exposure.
facts.quote: Track conversions that occur within a window (typically 7-30 days) after ad exposure, even without a click.

facts.fact: The guide states that CTV household matching is generally 70-80% accurate (vendor's own estimate, not a third-party measurement).
facts.quote: The accuracy is generally 70-80% for household matching.

facts.fact: Most CTV platforms require a minimum audience size for retargeting campaigns, typically around 1,000 to 5,000 matched households.
facts.quote: Most CTV platforms require a minimum audience size for retargeting campaigns, typically around 1,000 to 5,000 matched households.

facts.fact: Most platforms recommend waiting until the retargeting audience is sufficiently sized, usually after 2 to 4 weeks of website traffic, before launching CTV retargeting campaigns.
facts.quote: Most platforms recommend waiting until you have sufficient audience size (usually 2 to 4 weeks of traffic) before launching retargeting campaigns.
